card.name: Words just before 'today' or 'present'
card.fires_on: Small words (would, are, its, the, we) in history or counterfactual text, right before the text refers to the present day, such as 'today', 'now' or 'current'.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward present-time words like 'currently', 'today' and 'presently'.
